summary.independent_recompute: Recomputed from the 8 raw Zillow state files (51 regions x 8 types = 408 observations; 0 NaN, 0 non-positive values). Ranking and values reproduce exactly (max abs diff < 1e-3 pp).
notes: 51 regions = 50 states + District of Columbia; every region has exactly 8 house types, so the disparity is computed over 8 CAGRs per state.
Reported magnitude is unit-dependent (decimal 0.0423 vs pp 4.2281); the upstream file uses pp, and the top-5 ranking is unit-invariant, so selection is robust to this convention.
Gap between rank 5 (Kansas 2.4172 pp) and rank 6 (Texas 2.1623 pp) is 0.25 pp, so the top-5 cutoff is not a near-tie.
